ruleDefinitions.name: Linux HackTool Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects known hacktool execution based on image name.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/crackmapexec$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/havoc$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/merlin\\-agent$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/merlinServer\\-Linux\\-x64$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/msfconsole$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/msfvenom$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ps\\-empire\\ server$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ps\\-empire$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sliver\\-client$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sliver\\-server$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/Villain\\\.py$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\/cobaltstrike.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\/teamserver.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/autorecon$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/httpx$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/legion$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/naabu$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netdiscover$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nuclei$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/recon\\-ng$")) OR process_path = RGX(".*\\/sniper.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\/dirb$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/dirbuster$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/eyewitness$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/feroxbuster$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ffuf$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/gobuster$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/wfuzz$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/whatweb$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/joomscan$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nikto$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/wpscan$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/aircrack\\-ng$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/bloodhound\\-python$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/bpfdos$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ebpfki$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/evil\\-winrm$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/hashcat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/hoaxshell\\\.py$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/hydra$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/john$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ncrack$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nxc\\-ubuntu\\-latest$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/pidhide$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/pspy32$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/pspy32s$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/pspy64$") OR process_path =
